verdict.rationale: DLG says it serves foreign nationals "and their employers" and works with "company contacts and HR teams." It also handles the main employer-sponsored work visas (H-1B, L-1, TN, E-3, O-1), which implies a growing company could route several hires through one firm. However, the evidence shows no multi-case or portfolio management offering and no stated startup or scale-up program; its entrepreneur content covers single-founder O-1/E-2 scenarios only. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-employee case-management service or dashboard, a stated startup/scale-up employer program, and independent corroboration of handling team-wide immigration for growing companies.
